application_documents_binding_complete.name: application_documents_binding_complete
application_documents_binding_complete.value: ("app"."application_documents"."quarantine_bucket" is null and "app"."application_documents"."quarantine_key" is null and "app"."application_documents"."quarantine_version_id" is null) or ("app"."application_documents"."quarantine_bucket" is not null and "app"."application_documents"."quarantine_key" is not null and "app"."application_documents"."quarantine_version_id" is not null)

application_documents_clean_is_proven.name: application_documents_clean_is_proven
application_documents_clean_is_proven.value: "app"."application_documents"."scan_status" <> 'clean' or ("app"."application_documents"."quarantine_version_id" is not null and "app"."application_documents"."clean_version_id" is not null and "app"."application_documents"."scan_result" = 'NO_THREATS_FOUND' and "app"."application_documents"."scan_event_id" is not null and "app"."application_documents"."scan_decided_at" is not null)

lab_qr_checks_verified_has_both.name: lab_qr_checks_verified_has_both
lab_qr_checks_verified_has_both.value: "app"."lab_qr_checks"."state" <> 'verified' or ("app"."lab_qr_checks"."staff_event_id" is not null and "app"."lab_qr_checks"."student_event_id" is not null and "app"."lab_qr_checks"."verified_at" is not null)
